subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw make `channels.<channel>.accounts.<accountId>.*` reloads account-scoped by default for every channel plugin, or require explicit plugin opt-in first?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but changing reload fanout across all channel plugins is a compatibility-sensitive lifecycle policy choice that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Approve generic account-scoped reloads
options.body: Use the existing channel manager account-id lifecycle seam for account paths, with conservative whole-channel fallbacks for mixed, global, default-account, plugin-reload, and unsafe cases.

options.title: Require plugin opt-in
options.body: Keep current whole-channel behavior until each channel plugin declares account-scoped reload support explicitly.

recommendation.title: Approve generic account-scoped reloads
recommendation.body: Use the existing channel manager account-id lifecycle seam for account paths, with conservative whole-channel fallbacks for mixed, global, default-account, plugin-reload, and unsafe cases.
